breadcrumbs.name: MIFARE Classic Vs MIFARE Plus Vs DESFire For Hotel Locks

summary: This comparison is for hotel lock projects deciding whether to stay close to legacy card behavior, take a migration-minded step up or move into a higher-security credential path.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
MIFARE Classic - Legacy estates still validating older lock behavior - Common reference point in older hospitality programs

faq.question: Is DESFire automatically the right choice for hotel locks?
faq.answer: Not automatically. DESFire often suits higher-security programs well, but the current lock estate and migration pressure can still make MIFARE Plus the more practical path.

faq.question: Should hotels choose the chip family before checking encoder compatibility?
faq.answer: No. Encoder and lock compatibility should be part of the first chip-family decision because they shape which migration paths are realistic.
